company.name: Phantom
company.shortDescription: Phantom is a crypto wallet that facilitates the buying, trading, and storing of cryptocurrencies, including NFTs and tokens.
company.description: Phantom is a digital wallet reimagined for DeFi and NFTs. Phantom is a multichain wallet that supports various applications and allows users to manage their crypto and NFT assets across multiple blockchain networks, particularly Solana. The Phantom wallet is accessible through various platforms including mobile and browser extensions, making it versatile for all users engaging with digital finance.

productsAndServices.description: A self-custodial, multichain wallet for buying, storing, sending, and managing cryptocurrencies, tokens, and NFTs across supported blockchain networks.

productsAndServices.description: An in-wallet trading service for buying and selling supported cryptocurrencies, discovering tokens and traders, and accessing token-related applications.

productsAndServices.description: A free SDK and wallet infrastructure service that lets applications add social sign-in, embedded wallets, and secure transaction signing.

productsAndServices.description: A prepaid Visa debit card connected to Phantom’s money-management features for spending through Visa, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

productsAndServices.description: A prediction-market service that lets users trade contracts tied to outcomes of cultural and current events.

productsAndServices.description: A perpetual-futures trading service that supports long and short positions on eligible crypto assets.
